summary: The bounded five-population asynchronous-failure census for WK-2382, re-derived from the integrated SLICE-003/004/005 candidate. Duplicate mechanisms are collapsed to their retained owner BEFORE counting, so a removed copy is not an independent denominator member. Source shape does not decide safety: a suppression whose identical rejection is authoritatively observed elsewhere is closed, and an ENOENT-only catch that rethrows every other failure is closed, while a rejection that is only logged, permanently retained, or left without a settlement owner is not.
boundary: Exactly the eight modules of SLICE-006's read scope, and exactly the five WK-2382 populations. This is not repository-wide exception or code-literal discovery, which WK-2361 owns. WK-2361 CONSUMES and RECONCILES this closed corpus rather than rediscovering it; it does not own remediation of the sites recorded here. Assigning an owner to any residual below is coordinator closeout work on WK-2382, carried to an explicitly linked follow-on unit.

dispositions.evict_on_rejection_owned: Memoized through the single evict-on-rejection settlement owner: concurrent callers share one pending attempt, a rejection is evicted before the next authorized attempt, and success stays cached.
dispositions.non_masking_scoped_run_owner: Cleanup runs through a scoped-run owner that keeps the primary semantic failure, attaches cleanup failures as ordered secondary evidence, and attempts every remaining step.
dispositions.cleanup_failure_suppressed_bounded: The cleanup's own failure is deliberately and locally suppressed, so it has no path by which to replace the primary.
dispositions.synchronous_cleanup_no_failure_path: The finally body is a synchronous assignment with no rejection path, so it cannot mask.
dispositions.inner_catch_non_masking: The cleanup error is caught inside the finally body and never escapes to replace the primary.
dispositions.crash_durable_publication_owned_wk2357: Masking-capable handle-close cleanup inside crash-durable publication or lock layout. WK-2357 owns those semantics and WK-2382 records the site without remediating it.
dispositions.masking_capable_recorded_residual: Masking-capable cleanup with no owner inside WK-2382's named scope. Recorded here as an open residual for WK-2361 rather than silently remediated.
dispositions.suppression_observed_elsewhere: A detached suppression that prevents a DUPLICATE unhandled rejection while the identical promise is authoritatively awaited elsewhere. Closed.
dispositions.launcher_supervision_owned: Detachment whose settlement owner is launch-isolation-spawn's retained supervision, termination-attribution, and outcome machinery. WK-2382 reads that module and does not modify it.
dispositions.settles_owning_promise: A stream error listener that settles the promise owning the stream, so the error reaches exactly one awaited settlement.
dispositions.revokes_readiness: A stream error listener that requests fail-stop, moving the controller out of running.
dispositions.disables_diagnostic_sink: A stream error listener that disables the diagnostic sink terminally, so no later write targets a dead stream.
dispositions.fail_stop_owned: A process guard that emits one attributable terminal diagnostic, preserves its publication outcome, disables diagnostics, and requests fail-stop.
dispositions.accepted_static_module_map_memo: ACCEPTED NON-REMEDIATED. A memoized dynamic `import()` of a STATIC module specifier. Node's ESM module map permanently caches a module-evaluation failure and rethrows the identical error object on every later import of that specifier, so evicting the local memo cannot make the site retryable: the retained rejection lives in the loader, below anything the module owns. The site keeps its original local settlement shape deliberately. It is NOT an evict-owner site and must not be counted as one.
